name: RegisterBox public service packages
price_note: Final RegisterBox prices. No GST is added. Government fees and statutory dues are separate where applicable, except that the eligible FSSAI Basic Registration package includes the first annual government registration fee of ₹100. State and Central licences require a separate quote.

services.title: GST Registration
services.description: Get your business ready for GST with guided registration assistance.
services.fee_note: Final RegisterBox service fee. No GST is added. Ordinary GST registration has no government application fee.

services.title: FSSAI Basic Registration
services.description: Application assistance for one eligible premises, including the first annual government registration fee.
includes: Submission and query coordination for one new registration
First annual government registration fee of ₹100
services.fee_note: Final package price. No GST is added. Covers one new Basic Registration at one eligible premises and the first annual government fee. State and Central licences require a separate quote. Future annual fees, additional premises, modifications, testing, audits and local permissions are excluded. Approval is subject to the competent authority.
